verses.text: A branch there will come forth from the stump of Jesse, and a fresh shoot from his roots will bear fruit.

segments.text: A branch there will come forth from the stump of Jesse, and a fresh shoot from his roots will bear fruit.

verses.text: And will rest upon Him the Spirit of YHWH, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of YHWH.

segments.text: And will rest upon Him the Spirit of YHWH, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of YHWH.

verses.text: And His delight [is] in the fear of YHWH, and by the sight of His eyes He will not judge, and not by the hearing of his ears He will decide.

segments.text: And His delight [is] in the fear of YHWH, and by the sight of His eyes He will not judge, and not by the hearing of his ears He will decide.

verses.text: And He will judge the lowly with righteousness, and He will decide with straightness for the poor of the earth; and He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, and with the breath of His lips He will slay the wicked.

segments.text: And He will judge the lowly with righteousness, and He will decide with straightness for the poor of the earth; and He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, and with the breath of His lips He will slay the wicked.

verses.text: And righteousness will be the girdle of His waist, and faithfulness the girdle of His loins.

segments.text: And righteousness will be the girdle of His waist, and faithfulness the girdle of His loins.

verses.text: And the wolf will dwell with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together, and a little child will lead them.

segments.text: And the wolf will dwell with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together, and a little child will lead them.

verses.text: And the cow and the bear will graze; their young will lie down together, and the lion like the ox will eat straw.

segments.text: And the cow and the bear will graze; their young will lie down together, and the lion like the ox will eat straw.

verses.text: And the suckling will play over the hole of a cobra, and over the den of a viper the one being weaned will stretch out his hand.

segments.text: And the suckling will play over the hole of a cobra, and over the den of a viper the one being weaned will stretch out his hand.

verses.text: They will not harm and they will not destroy in all the mountain of My holiness; for the earth will be full [of] the knowledge of YHWH, as the waters are covering the sea.

segments.text: They will not harm and they will not destroy in all the mountain of My holiness; for the earth will be full [of] the knowledge of YHWH, as the waters are covering the sea.

verses.text: And in that day it will come to pass [that] the root of Jesse, which is standing, [will be] as a banner for the peoples; The nations will seek Him out, and His resting place will be [in] glory.

segments.text: And in that day it will come to pass [that] the root of Jesse, which is standing, [will be] as a banner for the peoples; The nations will seek Him out, and His resting place will be [in] glory.

verses.text: And it will come to pass in that day [that] the Lord will add a second [time] [with] His hand to recover the remnant of His people who will remain from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

segments.text: And it will come to pass in that day [that] the Lord will add a second [time] [with] His hand to recover the remnant of His people who will remain from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

verses.text: And He will lift up a banner for the nations, and He will gather the banished ones of Israel, and the dispersed ones of Judah He will gather together from the four wings of the earth.

segments.text: And He will lift up a banner for the nations, and He will gather the banished ones of Israel, and the dispersed ones of Judah He will gather together from the four wings of the earth.

verses.text: And the jealousy of Ephraim will be turned aside, and the adversaries of Judah will be cut off. Ephraim will not envy Judah and Judah will not harass Ephraim.

segments.text: And the jealousy of Ephraim will be turned aside, and the adversaries of Judah will be cut off. Ephraim will not envy Judah and Judah will not harass Ephraim.

verses.text: And they will fly down on the shoulder of the Philistines westward; together they will plunder the sons of the east. Upon Edom and Moab they will send forth their hands, and the sons of Ammon [will be] their subjects.

segments.text: And they will fly down on the shoulder of the Philistines westward; together they will plunder the sons of the east. Upon Edom and Moab they will send forth their hands, and the sons of Ammon [will be] their subjects.

verses.text: And YHWH will devote to destruction the tongue of the Sea of Egypt, and He will wave His hand over the River with the might of His wind, and will strike it into seven streams, for one to tread in sandals.

segments.text: And YHWH will devote to destruction the tongue of the Sea of Egypt, and He will wave His hand over the River with the might of His wind, and will strike it into seven streams, for one to tread in sandals.

verses.text: And there will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria, as it was for Israel in the day of his coming up from the land of Egypt.
